description.zh:
启用或禁用窗口

- **true**：启用。
- **false**：禁用。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable or disable the O&M window.

- **true**: Enabled.
- **false**: Disabled.

description.zh: 运维窗口的名称，可以自定义。长度不超过200给字符
description.en: The name of the O&M window. You can specify a custom name. The name can be up to 200 characters in length.

description.zh: 地域ID。您可以调用DescribeRegions查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call DescribeRegions to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 运维窗口支持的运维操作
description.en: The O&M operations supported by the O&M window.
The resources on which the O&M window takes effect.
The recurring cycle of the O&M window.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs create-plan-maintenance-window --plan-window-name WIndowName --enable true --support-maintenance-action Reboot --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --time-period '{"RangeList":[{"EndTime":"Tuesday,03:00","StartTime":"Monday,22:00"}],"PeriodUnit":"Weekly"}' --target-resource '{"Scope":"Tag","ResourceGroupId":"rg-aekzhm7pmnvcbty","Tags":[{"Value":"21.137.18.60","Key":"vms_qualification_孙总身份证_e5590864-1fef-4db2-b2a7-bd2d657fed43.png"}]}' --region cn-hangzhou
